title: Mandatory Lab evidence for AI development
statement: AI-affecting development SHALL use the selected local Lab and retain ai-development-run evidence before claiming observed AI completion; ordinary runtime SHALL remain usable without Lab. Specification-only and zero-call deterministic work SHALL keep their actual proof limits.
positive_setup: A mapping prompt/adapter increment with selected positive/negative cases
positive_expectation: the increment executes through Lab-linked native owners and saves exact evidence
negative_title: Ordinary use or unavailable development evidence
negative_setup: Lab is off or the selected development observations are missing
negative_expectation: ordinary learner grades remain usable and AI development is explicitly incomplete rather than reported verified
oracle: Selected dependency diff and actual experiment/observation receipts, not merely an enabled flag.

title: Complete inference surface inventory
statement: Development SHALL reconcile every owned remote/local inference and wrapper/helper/plugin path against ai-surface-inventory, including all fourteen declared surfaces and future additions. Static inventory SHALL not masquerade as runtime coverage.
positive_expectation: the inventory identifies its owner/serializer/trusted fragments and separate actual calls
negative_setup: A hidden helper SDK call or local model path absent from inventory
negative_expectation: dispatch reconciliation exposes it and the selected development coverage remains incomplete
oracle: Independent transport/local inference observer versus registered actual owner inventory.

title: Versioned trusted instruction sources
statement: Every trusted stage/schema/repair/fallback/judge/reference/adapter instruction fragment SHALL have an exact saved owner/hash. Dynamic answers/source/errors SHALL remain data, without hidden unversioned concatenation or recursive instruction expansion.
positive_setup: A request includes a schema description and semantic-repair wrapper
positive_expectation: their actual text/role/order and source hashes are reconstructable
negative_setup: An adapter appends an unregistered instruction or evaluates answer text as a template
negative_expectation: the mismatch is observed and no complete controlled-context claim is issued
oracle: Actual serialized request bytes compared to independently listed trusted fragment sources.

title: Exact model-visible snapshots
statement: Each actual model call SHALL save the final noncredential request after all serialization/defaults and before dispatch, with actual part/asset hashes, modalities and framing. Non-LLM speech/ASR inputs SHALL be inspectable too.
positive_title: Inspect speech and LLM actual inputs
positive_setup: A JSON LLM call and SSML/audio reference call
positive_expectation: actual model-visible bytes/parameters match their saved snapshots
negative_setup: A serializer or SDK alters a default/role/prompt after snapshot creation
negative_expectation: transport mismatch is retained as incomplete snapshot coverage instead of relying on template hashes
oracle: Independent actual transport/local argument capture versus snapshot-byte hashes.

title: All attempt outcomes and caches accounted
statement: Every initial/retry/fallback/repair/local/judge attempt SHALL retain distinct actual snapshots/receipts/spans, including failures/cancellation/late outputs. Cache views SHALL reference the original call without inventing a new dispatch.
positive_setup: An initial call is repaired and later inspected from cache
positive_expectation: two real attempts and one cache reference retain distinct lineage and real usage
negative_setup: An attempt refuses/errors/crashes after dispatch or an exporter drops it
negative_expectation: the initiated attempt stays in the denominator and unresolved outcome/export stays explicit
oracle: Observed dispatch identities and lineage, not successful-row counts.

title: Context disclosure and budget fidelity
statement: Development SHALL exercise actual stage disclosure/budget selection: blind extraction omits keys/prior scores; independent audit omits mapper results; mapping/feedback retain required frozen inputs; ASR/reference conditioning remains explicit.
positive_setup: A fixed answer/key and actual native result enter the selected pipeline
positive_expectation: each stage sees exactly its allowed required components and explicit optional selections
negative_setup: A custom policy adds the key to blind extraction, first-map decisions to audit or removes required answer bytes
negative_expectation: the actual assembled context exposes the defect and no accurate-grade/independence claim is made
oracle: Final per-stage input asset versus independent allowed/required-input expectations.

title: Variant binding and cache isolation
statement: Prompt/context/fragment/schema/recipe/model/voice/input parameter changes SHALL affect the relevant frozen binding/cache identity. Editing/activation SHALL preserve earlier saved attempts and use the actual selected version, without hidden fallback.
positive_title: Changed variant executes its own binding
positive_setup: A selected trusted fragment or model-visible parameter differs from baseline
positive_expectation: new calls use that exact variant and old answers/results retain their original binding
negative_setup: A mutable alias changes or a cache entry has another effective input identity
negative_expectation: the run does not reuse the mismatched decision or silently substitute a profile
oracle: Frozen full binding/input dependency hashes plus actual dispatched model/parameters.

title: Measured semantic change evidence
statement: AI development SHALL select affected positive/negative cases and actual dependent pipelines with frozen independent expectations, preserving failed/unperformed rows, all122coverage reporting and existing exact arithmetic. Unsupported quality improvement claims SHALL remain unproven.
positive_title: Paired change with real failure counts
positive_setup: A baseline/candidate comparison on the same fixed reference population
positive_expectation: paired metrics retain actual origins/denominators and relevant dependent cases
negative_setup: Candidate-made labels, leaked expected answers, excluded failures or unselected leaves
negative_expectation: the report labels self-consistency/missing coverage and cannot claim independent improvement/full coverage
oracle: Frozen reference assets and native formula sufficient statistics independent of the candidate.

title: Observable and challenged judges
statement: Judges/scorers SHALL use frozen rubric/prompt/profile/schema identities and actual trace/receipts, with correct/incorrect/unknown test packets. Judge agreement SHALL not replace native arithmetic or absent acoustic evidence.
positive_setup: Known correct/incorrect/unsupported packets and a selected diagnostic judge
positive_expectation: saved verdicts/receipts expose false support/rejection/unknown handling with actual basis
negative_setup: The candidate grades its own labels or text-only judge claims observed phones
negative_expectation: the circular/unsupported inference is retained and cannot establish independent/measured correctness
oracle: Withheld authored packet expectations, exact native arithmetic and actual modality evidence.

title: Private but inspectable diagnostic artifacts
statement: Development SHALL explicitly select permitted body capture and preserve private original/sanitized hashes and redaction reasons. It SHALL never export credentials/private source fields or claim complete body inspection after an undisclosed omission.
positive_setup: Permitted context plus controlled secret/private-field canaries
positive_expectation: Lab copies omit those fields while original grading bytes and separate hashes stay correct
negative_setup: Source terms prohibit copying a component or redaction/export loses required content
negative_expectation: inspection limits remain explicit instead of fake full capture or an exported secret
oracle: Actual canary bytes/assets versus allowed export projection and unchanged original input hash.

title: Export outages do not falsify development evidence
statement: Lab export failure SHALL preserve native results and mark AI development evidence incomplete; explicit sync SHALL export the same saved observations without inference. Restore/deletion SHALL preserve honest pending status.
positive_setup: A completed operation has native evidence and a transient Lab outage
positive_expectation: sync restores exact diagnostic linkage without a new model call
negative_setup: Lab artifacts remain unavailable or copied-body deletion fails
negative_expectation: the run retains missing/pending items and cannot claim successful synchronization/deletion
oracle: Native dispatch count before/after sync and actual Lab artifact identity/cleanup receipt.

title: Coverage completeness and precise invalidation
statement: Development SHALL reconcile independently observed dispatches, native snapshots/receipts and actual MLflow exports using the exact selected property/case/dependency inventory. Unmatched paths and zero populations SHALL remain explicit; unchanged valid greens SHALL be retained.
positive_setup: Observed transport/local dispatches and matching native/Lab records
positive_expectation: the three-way join covers every required selected observation and names unselected paths
negative_setup: A dispatch is missing, duplicate export replaces another, zero calls claim integration or an unrelated edit triggers all tests
negative_expectation: coverage remains incomplete/N/A as applicable and only truly changed dependency proofs rerun
oracle: Independent dispatch population, bijective receipt/snapshot/export correspondence and saved semantic dependency hashes.
